p.title: Worker transport boundary: body deadline, streamed size cap, redirect policy
p.symptom: Codex structural review: the relay and the generic proxy cleared their timeout once headers arrived, capped size only through Content-Length, and followed redirects without re-checking the destination.
p.root_cause: Each fetch path handled transport inline with fetch defaults.
p.fix: cloudflare-worker-proxy.js fetchUpstream() follows at most three redirects manually, checking each hop (relay: same provider host over https; proxy: private-host block + domain allowlist); readUpstreamText() streams the body under the same deadline and refuses more than 5MB; errors keep their kind (timeout / too large / redirect refused).
p.violated_rule: One transport boundary owns time, size and destination.
p.prevention: ci-worker-relay-check P1413 (off-host redirect refused, 6MB stream without Content-Length refused, same-host redirect followed).
p.verification: Worker relay, proxy continuity and quota gates pass.

changelog: **Worker 전송 경계 (P1413):** 응답 본문까지 제한 시간 적용, 실제 수신 바이트로 5MB 제한, redirect 도착지를 매번 허용 목록으로 재검사.
